title: Keyboard manager: doesn't detect re-mapping PgUp>Home and PgDown>End anymore w/ v0.92.1

status.label: Reproduce the PgUp/Home regression on current release
status.detail: The reporter provides a before/after version comparison and exact mappings; no current-release result or ownership is recorded.

judgment.rationale: The reporter gives a concrete regression: PgUp-to-Home and PgDown-to-End key mappings, plus Alt+Left/Right shortcut mappings, worked on 0.91.1 but stopped on 0.92.1 in Word and Notepad++. They later asked for a response, but no current-version check or maintainer ownership is recorded. A current stable result will determine whether this remains active or is already resolved.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.92.1 on Windows 11 23H2 and says 0.91.1 worked.
The exact key and shortcut mappings and test applications are described.
The reporter posted follow-ups on 2025-10-06 and 2025-12-10 asking whether anyone is addressing the issue.
Related issue #44201 was closed as a duplicate in favor of this issue; it does not establish that the bug was fixed.
The issue is open and unassigned; no covering PR or fix was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether either mapping still fails on current stable; if it does, reproduce the key and shortcut paths in Word and Notepad++ before proposing a code change.

fix_assessment.rationale: The version comparison supports a possible Keyboard Manager regression affecting both key and shortcut remapping, but a current build has not been tested and the issue does not identify a failing code path.

proposed_fixes.title: Restore the reported PgUp/Home and PgDown/End remappings
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A change between PowerToys 0.91.1 and 0.92.1 may have affected detection or dispatch of these key and shortcut mappings. The report does not establish whether the two mapping types share a failing path.
plan: Confirm each mapping on current stable and compare with the reported 0.91.1/0.92.1 behavior if the regression remains.
Trace Keyboard Manager key remapping and shortcut remapping for PgUp, PgDown, Home, End, and the Alt+Arrow combinations.
Correct the confirmed regression while preserving ordinary key behavior and application compatibility.
Add focused coverage for the key and shortcut mappings in the affected input path.
verification: Verify PgUp-to-Home and PgDown-to-End at the start/end of a line in Word and Notepad++.
Verify the Alt+Left/Right-to-Home/End alternatives if the key mapping remains broken.
Confirm the mappings behave consistently on current stable without disabling Keyboard Manager.

confidence.rationale: The before/after version comparison and exact mappings are useful evidence, but current behavior and the failing code path remain unverified.

issue_context.summary: Keyboard Manager key remappings PgUp-to-Home and PgDown-to-End, and alternative Alt+Arrow shortcut remappings, reportedly stopped working in 0.92.1 after working in 0.91.1.
known_information: The reporter lists Windows 11 23H2 and tests in Microsoft Word and Notepad++.
PgUp-to-Home and PgDown-to-End worked in PowerToys 0.91.1 but not 0.92.1; Alt+Left/Right-to-Home/End alternatives also stopped working.
The reporter has asked for a response twice.
Issue #44201 was closed as a duplicate in favor of this report; no fix is linked.
inferences: The timing suggests a regression between the two releases, but does not establish whether it persists in current stable or whether both mapping types share a cause.
issue_context.analysis: The report is specific enough for a maintainer reproduction, and the reporter has already supplied substantial detail. A current-version confirmation is the remaining key distinction; do not treat the duplicate closure as evidence of resolution.
initial_investigation: Read the issue body, all comments, labels, state, and linked timeline references.
Reviewed #44201, which was closed as a duplicate in favor of this report; its comment does not provide a fix.
Reviewed the AI-suggested #33364 and found it concerns remapping intermittently failing in WSLg, not these PgUp/Home mappings.

information_gaps.information: Whether the key and shortcut mappings still fail on current stable PowerToys, with the exact current version
information_gaps.why_needed: The last explicit test was on 0.92.1, so a later release may already have changed the behavior; current status determines whether implementation work is still needed.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On current stable, test PgUp-to-Home and PgDown-to-End in Word or Notepad++; if they fail, also test the reported Alt+Left/Right-to-Home/End alternatives and report the exact PowerToys version.

comment.body: Thanks for providing the 0.91.1-versus-0.92.1 comparison and exact mappings; the duplicate report was closed in favor of this issue, not as a fix. Could you confirm whether PgUp-to-Home and PgDown-to-End still fail on current stable PowerToys, and include the exact version? If they do, please also say whether the Alt+Left/Right alternatives still fail in Word or Notepad++. No new diagnostic upload is needed for this focused check.

actions.note: Test both the reported direct-key mappings and shortcut alternatives in the named applications.

reproduce.title: Verify PgUp/Home and PgDown/End mappings
setup: Map PgUp to Home and PgDown to End in Keyboard Manager.
Optionally configure Alt+Left and Alt+Right to Home and End as the reported alternatives.
steps: In Word or Notepad++, place the caret in the middle of a line.
Press PgUp and PgDown separately and observe whether the caret moves to the start and end of the line.
If the direct-key mappings fail, test the configured Alt+Left and Alt+Right alternatives.
reproduce.expected_result: The remappings should move the caret to the start/end of the line as configured.
